name: Wishing
overview: Scripture reveals that God responds to the desires and petitions of His people when aligned with His will, as seen in Psalms 20:4 where God grants according to the heart's counsel and in Matthew 7:7 encouraging believers to ask, seek, and knock for their needs. The blessing promised in Genesis 12:3 and exaltation in Deuteronomy 28:1 demonstrate that God’s favor is linked to obedience and His sovereign purpose. Ultimately, the fulfillment of God's promises centers on Christ, the Word who was with God and is God (John 1:1), and whose coming was foretold as a divine sign in Isaiah 7:14, emphasizing that true hope and blessing rest in Him rather than mere human wishing.
